Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_TASK_LOOT_0
Text: Pick up supplies for the Resistance.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_TASK_LOOT_1
Text: Loot the enemy bodies for supplies.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_0
Text: Great job, kid! I knew I could count on you! There's always something to do around here - if not today, then tomorrow for sure.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_1
Text: Well, well. Looks like you pulled thru. Good work. Here's your reward - go paint the town red.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_3
Text: Oh, man! I could see you stir up all kinds of trouble back there! It's amazing you're still walking! Good work, absolutely.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_4
Text: What, you expect a medal or something? You did a fine job, but don't rest on your laurels, all complacent. The resistance isn't at war just on this island, you know?

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_5
Text: Mission accomplished, eh? Well, now! This sure paints a big smile on my face. Here's something for your troubles.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_6
Text: Good going! Let me know if you want another job - I'm sure that by sometime tomorrow I'll have something else that needs to be done.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_7
Text: With soldiers like you on our side, toppling Labycore is just a matter of time. Excellent work, kid. Excellent.

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_8
Text: Glad you made it back. Hope it didn't get too hairy!

Name: TID_DAILY_RANDOM_MISSION_RECEIVE_9
Text: Sweet. I just love the sound of automatic weapons.
